note: Packs (book/scripts/modules/packs.mjs; canon .spw/surfaces/texture-website.spw). A pack adds to lore.land without changing what is there: it lives where its route says (book/content/packs/<surface>/@<who>/), answers that route (lore.land/?/<surface>/@<who>), lists what it brings, and links every source where it lives. Removing its line here removes it. A maker's pack has a maker, a depiction scheme and a curriculum; an expansion has neither. book:check holds every pack's files and plans.
